package_info.package_name: PowerTrash Loader (delivered via CVE-2022-22954 exploit chain)
package_info.package_manager: N/A (malware delivered via remote code execution, not a package manager)
package_info.package_versions: N/A (affects VMware Workspace ONE Access and related products vulnerable to CVE-2022-22954, CVE-2022-22957, CVE-2022-22958)
package_info.why_malicious: The entire attack chain is malicious because it leverages a critical RCE vulnerability to execute arbitrary code on the target system, downloads and executes a highly obfuscated loader (PowerTrash), and loads a post-exploitation agent (Core Impact) for full remote control, persistence, and further exploitation.

execution_context.file_location: Injected into the vulnerable VMware service process (e.g., Identity Manager web service)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code executes a PowerShell command that downloads and executes a remote script from a C2 server, enabling the attacker to run arbitrary code on the compromised system.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: This behavior is suspicious because it uses PowerShell to download and execute code from an external, attacker-controlled server, a common technique for initial malware staging.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal VMware services should not invoke PowerShell to download and execute remote scripts.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: System administrators may use similar commands for remote management, but only in tightly controlled, logged, and authorized scenarios.
key_indicators: PowerShell execution with -nop (no profile) and -w hidden (window hidden)

execution_context.file_location: Memory (downloaded and executed by stager PowerShell script)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: <Highly obfuscated PowerTrash loader PowerShell code, downloaded from C2 server>
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the obfuscated PowerShell loader is executed in memory, which downloads and injects the Core Impact agent into the process, establishing a persistent backdoor and C2 channel.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The use of highly obfuscated PowerShell code to load a post-exploitation agent is a hallmark of advanced malware and red team tools.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate software should not use obfuscated scripts to inject code into memory or establish unauthorized C2 channels.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Red team or penetration testing engagements may use similar techniques, but only with explicit authorization.
key_indicators: Download and execution of post-exploitation agent

attack_chain.action: Exploit CVE-2022-22954 to achieve remote code execution on the VMware service.
attack_chain.leads_to: Ability to execute arbitrary commands on the target system

attack_chain.action: Execute a PowerShell stager to download and run a remote script from the attacker's C2 server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Download and execution of the PowerTrash loader

attack_chain.action: Run the highly obfuscated PowerTrash loader, which downloads and injects the Core Impact agent into memory.
attack_chain.leads_to: Establish persistent C2 channel and full remote control

behavioral_signatures: PowerShell execution with -nop and -w hidden flags
PowerShell downloading and executing remote scripts via DownloadString and IEX
In-memory execution of obfuscated PowerShell code
Process injection and loading of post-exploitation agents
file_indicators: No persistent files; activity occurs in memory
Unusual PowerShell process invocation by VMware service processes
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests to suspicious or unknown C2 domains/IPs
Connections to known Core Impact C2 infrastructure
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for PowerShell processes spawned by VMware service accounts, especially those using -nop and -w hidden flags. Detect network connections from VMware servers to external IPs/domains not associated with legitimate updates. Look for in-memory execution of obfuscated PowerShell code and process injection behaviors. Correlate with known C2 infrastructure and analyze logs for exploitation of CVE-2022-22954 and related vulnerabilities.
